caption:
An extremely dark, heavily out-of-focus scene fills the frame. A bare forearm enters from the upper-right edge toward the top center, where a hand is partly visible. Two bright cyan-white rectangular light patches sit in the mid-ground, with thinner vertical streaks below them. A colorful patterned vertical band of green, pink, and purple swirls occupies the left-center beside a dark amorphous mass.
Throughout the excerpt the two main rectangular light patches change shape, size, and brightness. The left patch becomes more rounded and square as its top edge lowers, while the right patch changes shape and develops an irregular notched edge. A chain-like string of small bright dots appears in the upper-left region during the later frames, absent at the start, while the forearm and hand remain largely in place with only minor positional shifts.
The colorful vertical band and the central dark mass stay roughly fixed in position, suggesting a near-static camera. The visible changes are confined to the glowing patches and the emerging dot-chain, and the process continues uninterrupted to the final frame.
